In addition, our EDNS Client Subnet implementation now scales effortlessly to networks needing very fine-grained scopes (as used by some ‘country sized’ service providers). - Improved DNSSEC support, - Improved documentation, - Improved RPZ support, - Improved EDNS Client Subnet support, - Support for Botan 2.x (and removal of support for Botan 1.10), - SNMP support, - Lua engine has gained access to more parts of the recursor, - CPU affinity can now be specified, - TCP Fast Open support, - New performance metrics. Changes since 4.1.0-rc3:
